news.title: ChatGPT finally offers $100/month Pro plan
news.description: OpenAI announced on Thursday something that power users have been asking for: a $100/month plan. Previously, subscriptions jumped from $20 to $200 per month.

news.title: Meta AI app climbs to No. 5 on the App Store after Muse Spark launch
news.description: The app was ranking No. 57 on the App Store just before Meta AI's new model launched. Now it's No. 5 — and rising.

news.title: Dancer with MND performs on stage again through digital avatar
news.description: Breanna Olson said brainwave tech was able to re-establish the expression and connection she felt had gone.

news.title: AI Podcasters Really Want to Tell You How to Keep a Man Happy
news.description: Videos of fake relationship guru podcasters are reinforcing gender tropes and racking up millions of views, all the while driving sales to AI influencer schools.

news.title: Meta’s New AI Asked for My Raw Health Data—and Gave Me Terrible Advice
news.description: Meta’s Muse Spark model offers to analyze users’ health data, including lab results. Beyond the obvious privacy risks, it’s not a capable stand-in for a real doctor.

news.title: OpenAI Backs Bill That Would Limit Liability for AI-Enabled Mass Deaths or Financial Disasters
news.description: The ChatGPT-maker testified in favor of an Illinois bill that would limit when AI labs can be held liable—even in cases where their products cause “critical harm.”

news.title: The 70-Person AI Image Startup Taking on Silicon Valley's Giants
news.description: Black Forest Labs has long punched above its weight in the AI image generation space. Its next move? Powering physical AI.
